intro: Catalyst Chambers is a New Delhi-based law practice led by Adv. Rohit Ghosh, offering comprehensive legal solutions across litigation, arbitration, and corporate advisory. We are dedicated to justice and committed to providing strategic, solution-oriented representation to every client.

profile.label: Founder & Lead Advocate
profile.name: Rohit Ghosh
paragraphs: Rohit Ghosh is a New Delhi-based Advocate with over 10 years of experience. He has learned under the tutelage of top senior advocates in India, including Ms. Indira Jaising and Mr. Prashanto Chandra Sen, and gained extensive experience at Khaitan & Co. LLP, a leading law firm in India, handling end-to-end case management for top companies and high net worth individuals.

He has appeared in many landmark cases of constitutional importance before the Supreme Court of India and the Delhi High Court, and focuses on advocating for the rights of citizens, procedural fairness, corporate diligence, and good governance.

timeline.role: Advocate, Chambers of Mr. Rohit Ghosh
timeline.desc: Running an independent litigation and corporate advisory practice for companies, entities, organizations, and individuals in the New Delhi area.

timeline.role: Associate, Chambers of Mr. Prashanto Chandra Sen, Senior Advocate
timeline.desc: Worked across civil & commercial litigation, arbitration, infrastructure disputes, insolvency, mining, electoral, and constitutional matters.

timeline.role: Senior Associate, Khaitan & Co. LLP, New Delhi
timeline.desc: Six years handling high-profile clients — case management, legal strategy, and corporate/regulatory advisories across civil, commercial, insolvency, arbitration, and banking matters.

timeline.role: Associate, Chambers of Ms. Bina Gupta, Advocate-on-Record
timeline.desc: Appeared before the Supreme Court, High Court, District Courts, and Tribunals in constitutional, commercial, IBC, and consumer matters.

timeline.role: Associate, Chambers of Ms. Indira Jaising, Senior Advocate
